- [P0] Dividing by zero makes average fail for every input — /tmp/codex-web-final-fixes/workspace/composer-flash-owned-1793082533805-2394110/calculator.py:2-2
  `average` now divides `sum(values)` by the literal `0`, so every call raises `ZeroDivisionError` regardless of the input; the divisor should be `len(values)` (with empty-input handling if required by the caller).
